description: List orders, defaulting to open/incomplete orders. Filter by symbol, status, side, order_type or product_type. Set all=true to include completed orders. Use order_get via orderly_run for one specific order.

all.description: Show all orders (overrides default INCOMPLETE filter)

network.description: Network override for this call. Defaults to ORDERLY_MCP_NETWORK, then the CLI config.

order_type.description: Filter by type: LIMIT, MARKET One of: LIMIT, MARKET, IOC, FOK, POST_ONLY.

product_type.description: Filter by product type: PERP or BINARY One of: PERP, BINARY.

side.description: Filter by side: BUY, SELL One of: BUY, SELL.

status.description: Filter by status. Individual: NEW, FILLED, CANCELLED, PARTIAL_FILLED, REJECTED. Bundled: INCOMPLETE, COMPLETED. Default: INCOMPLETE

name: order_list
title: List orders
